item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Wildcard domain support in Azure Firewall network rules
item.description:
Azure Firewall network rules now support wildcard domains in FQDN-based rules and are generally available. Customers can use patterns such as *.contoso.com to simplify rule management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Firewall for Containers
item.description:
Azure Firewall for Containers is in public preview. It extends Azure Firewall protections to containerized workloads so network traffic for container environments can be secured and managed centrally.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Firewall IPv6 now supports application rules
item.description:
Azure Firewall IPv6 is now in public preview for application rules, adding layer 7 filtering for IPv6 HTTP and HTTPS traffic. This extends application-level controls to IPv6 and dual-stack deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Firewall auto-learn SNAT routes
item.description:
Azure Firewall auto-learn SNAT routes is now generally available. It periodically learns registered and private destination prefixes and applies them as No-SNAT ranges to preserve original source IPs and reduce manual SNAT management.

  • Source: Azure Updates
